functionality: disable system security features such as firewalls or automatic updates
adds application to Windows Registry for persistence
download and run additional malicious scripts
operational_techniques: typosquatting, where malicious actors create packages with names strikingly similar to legitimate ones to deceive developers
malicious_execute_phase: fetches and executes executables hosted on GitHub
persistence is established through Windows registry modifications
sensitive data is gathered and exfiltrated to attacker's server via Discord webhook
QuasarRAT (remote access trojan) is deployed on the system
impact: deployment of additional payloads such as Quasar RAT
mitigation_measures: thoroughly vetting packages before incorporation into projects
verifying the authenticity of packages, especially those resembling popular libraries
monitoring suspicious activities in the open-source software ecosystem
promptly reporting malicious packages to npm’s security team
